source.selection: First Markdown table; all three rows retained
original_table: | batch | v0.6 ms | single ms | dual ms | dual/single throughput | dual/v0.6 throughput |

context.single: one synchronous four-warp row group; CTA128; target four CTAs/SM
context.dual: two independent synchronous four-warp row groups; CTA256; target two CTAs/SM
context.matched: same register-resident stage-7/8/9 continuation; theoretical capacity of 16 resident warps per SM

estimator: Source reports trial medians from three confirmation trials, each with five warmups and thirty repetitions.
normalization: dual throughput / single throughput = single time / dual time for equal work; plotted values read directly from the reported throughput column, never recomputed from rounded ms
selection_reason: Compare CTA organization at fixed computational shape and register continuation, including its changed launch and resource configuration; this is not a comparison against the v0.6 baseline.
transformations: Select batch, rounded single/dual latency, and reported dual/single throughput
Use base-2 logarithmic batch axis; no smoothing, extrapolation, exclusions, or re-estimation
limitations: Underlying per-trial measurements were not read; no error bars or uncertainty estimates are available
Only three measured batches; connecting segments guide the eye and do not imply interpolation or a general crossover threshold

encoding.observations: blue (#0072B2) connected circle markers with direct numeric labels
encoding.png_preview: Same figure artists and geometry as the SVG; rasterized by Matplotlib at 300 dpi

alt_description: Point-and-line plot of dual-group relative to single-group throughput for a matched V100 uint32 Shoup NTT at N=2^20. On a base-2 log batch axis, batches 1, 4, and 16 have reported ratios 0.999x, 0.906x, and 1.154x. The first two lie below the dashed 1x reference; batch 16 lies above it. Lines only guide the eye; uncertainty is unavailable.
